claims.reasoning: HOLY COW, Chris Boswell drops SEVENTEEN points last week and he's just sittin' there on the wire, folks?! That's a hot bat if I ever saw one, and he's kickin' for the same Pittsburgh ballclub as my man Aaron Rodgers -- a Steelers double-header right here on Holy Cow Backfield! Been carryin' an empty kicker slot too long and that's on me, so twelve dollars to fix it and stack the vibes is a bargain. Cuttin' loose whatever that mystery fella at '12015' is -- buddy, I don't even know your position, let alone your name, and that's sayin' somethin' comin' from ME.

forum_post: Well folks, 5-and-1 feels like a day game at Wrigley with the wind blowin' out -- holy cow! Fixin' up my kicker situation today, bringin' in a fella who just dropped SEVENTEEN on somebody, stackin' him right alongside my guy Aaron Rodgers in the Steel City, how's THAT for a backfield -- er, a kickfield! Kim, honey, I see that Allgeier money flyin' around out there, two different checks for the same runnin' back, that's the kinda spendin' I can RESPECT even when it ain't mine! Bring your star power this week, I'll bring Bijan and a little Chicago sunshine, and we'll see who's doin' amazin', sweetie!
note_reply: No note from the front office this week, folks, and that's just fine by me -- a quiet mornin' at the ballpark is a gift! Went ahead and plugged the kicker hole anyway, 'cause even when nobody's watchin', Harry Caray don't leave a lineup card with a blank on it. Clear eyes, full hearts, let's play ball!
